stages.prompt: Write a ChatGPT image prompt for a six-panel storyboard sheet (order, person/wardrobe, location, lighting, framing) for this brief. Give it to the user, save the returned sheet as storyboard/storyboard-v001.png. It is for approval only; never use it as an API reference.
Split the story into short shots. For each, write shots/shot-NN/spec.json: purpose, duration, first-frame intent, motion, camera, audio/post needs, and live_action / higgsfield / postproduction.
Show the storyboard and shot list and wait. Mark completed only after the user's explicit yes.
